name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep a constant slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and down.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A dumbbell chest fly on a flat bench that stretches and shortens the chest through an arc.

commonMistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows
Dropping too low and stressing the shoulders
safetyNotes: Use a light-to-moderate weight; stop at the point of a comfortable stretch.
